author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Yuri and Anna from @vfminiatures take command of two powerful Deathwatch Kill Teams who have been tasked with hunting down the remnants of an insidious Genestealer Cult.  Their hunt brings them to the mysterious world of Karthax 9, a planet terraformed during the Age of Technology, but then never colonized by the Imperium.

Members to watch Episode 2, go here
Youtube Members - https://youtu.be/HlmfBYjKOPI
